annotations.title: Read a part, or list recent ones (Overwing CAD)

description: With an id from cad_create: the job's status. While it is building, ask again in about 20 seconds. When complete: the title, the script, the measurements, the checks that were run, part_url (a page showing the part in 3D with download buttons; give this to the person) and files_url (direct downloads of the STEP and STL files), kept for 30 days. When failed: why, and the credits were given back. With no id: the account's recent jobs, so a lost id is found again without starting a second part. Free. Needs the same organization key that started the job.

id.description: The job id from cad_create. Leave out to list recent jobs.
